description: Finds the product categories that have a published Pickbench brand board, by words of the category code or a brand name on the board (e.g. "running shoes", "tires", "Michelin"). Matching is deterministic text matching; nothing is sent to any model. Returns category codes, the brands on each board and the ids of published battles in the category. Read-only.

locale.description: Language of the human-readable text: en, ru or es (default en). Codes, names and ids stay untranslated.

query.description: Words to match, e.g. hiking shoes.

name: search_categories
title: Search categories
